title: Far from the Madding Crowd

vibeProfile.oneLine: An independent woman inherits a farm and juggles three suitors.

summary: The spirited and independent Bathsheba Everdene inherits a farm and finds herself pursued by three very different men: a steadfast shepherd, a prosperous older farmer, and a dashing, faithless soldier. Set in Hardy's beloved rural Wessex, this is his warmest major novel, a beautifully observed story of love, mistake and the rhythms of country life. More hopeful than his later tragedies, it pairs a strong-willed heroine with some of the loveliest writing about the English countryside.
whyReadIt: Hardy's warmest novel, a strong heroine and three suitors in beautiful rural Wessex. His most hopeful major book.

funFacts.text: It was the first of Hardy's novels set in his fictional region of Wessex.
